subject: Compliance MAP: data lifecycle, SOC 2 scope & SIG/CAIQ path
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Bates <elaine.bates@fintechplus.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance MAP: data lifecycle, SOC 2 scope & SIG/CAIQ path

Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to get clarity on FinTech Plus's acceptance criteria. Per our discussion I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that shows the evaluation milestones and the security/compliance gates we need to close before contract signature. The three items you highlighted that will determine timelines on your side are: SOC 2 readiness (evidence collection), SIG/CAIQ answers for our managed-hosted variant, and the DPA redline + data retention specifics.

Quick asks so we can finalize the MAP by end of next week:
- Can you confirm the SOC 2 report timeframe you need (ISO week or specific date)?
- Are there any mandatory CAIQ controls you want us to prioritize (e.g., 2.2.3 encryption-in-transit, 3.1.1 key management)?
- Data retention: please confirm your required retention window for logs vs. model outputs (we’ve put a default proposal in the MAP).

Attachments in this email: Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (timeline + owners), SIG-CAIQ_Answers_abridged.pdf (prelim answers), Draft_DPA_Redline.docx (our starting redline).

Proposed close plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Align MAP owners + finalize SOC 2 scope
- Week 1: Deliver full SIG/CAIQ answers & DPA redline
- Week 2: Evidence sprint (customer-provided artifacts + our artifact pack)
- Week 3: Legal sign-off & DocuSign

If that looks reasonable I’ll update the MAP with the dates you confirm and send a DocuSign request for the commercial term sheet.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elaine Bates <elaine.bates@fintechplus.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintechplus.com
Date: 2027-07-19T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance MAP: data lifecycle, SOC 2 scope & SIG/CAIQ path

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the MAP and the attachments; helpful. Quick answers:
- SOC 2: we need a SOC 2 Type II report that covers the period ending no earlier than 2027-06-30. If you can provide an interim bridge letter or an SOC 2 timeline that helps us close faster, that would be ideal.
- CAIQ: priority controls are encryption-at-rest + in-transit, key rotation documentation, separation of customer data, and incident response SLAs.
- Data retention: regulatory requires us to retain transaction-layer logs for 7 years, operational logs for 1 year, and we cannot retain raw model outputs beyond 90 days unless explicitly agreed and redacted.

We’ll review the Draft_DPA_Redline and circle back with redline comments by COB Tuesday. For the SIG/CAIQ answers, your abridged doc is a good start — we may ask for a few clarifications.

Can your CS/Eng team host a 30-minute evidence walkthrough next Monday (7/26) to show where artifacts live and to confirm timelines?

Regards,
Elaine Bates
VP, IT Risk & Compliance
FinTech Plus
elaine.bates@fintechplus.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: evidence & DPA items to prep for FinTech Plus

Kim / Jordan —

FYI I reviewed the SIG/CAIQ abridged and Elaine's retention constraints. A few internal notes and proposed owners before the evidence call:

- SOC 2 artifacts:
  * Controls matrix (owner: Compliance) — include control mappings to our runtime and hosted infra.
  * Change management logs (owner: Platform Eng) — we can produce a filtered export for the audit window.
  * Pen test report (owner: Security) — latest dated 2027-05.

- SIG/CAIQ clarifications needed:
  * Key management: show KMS scope (customer vs. platform keys) and rotation cadence.
  * Data separation: include diagram + multi-tenant isolation doc.

- Data retention specifics:
  * Transaction logs — can export to customer S3/transfer for long-term archive; need to confirm transfer SLA.
  * Model outputs — propose default 90-day retention, with ability to set 0-90 via policy per customer. Documented in DPA Appendix B.

Action items I’ll take before the FinTech Plus walkthrough on 2027-07-26:
- Prepare artifact index and short demo of evidence export (marcus.lin@redwood.com)
- Draft Appendix B for retention options for legal to review (jordan.blake@redwood.com)

If there are any other items from sales/legal I should fold in let me know.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
